source_location: Main PDF page2 section2.2, NHC phenyl vs salen naphthyl
original_rule: Choose closest two aromatic rings from each reconstructed graph; publish all ring atom IDs and centroid/normal definitions. Compare same rings in contact-separated and released structures.
new_rule: Use the nonbonded source motif: the six-carbon phenyl ring of the cyclometalated NHC ligand versus a fused six-carbon naphthyl ring of the salen ligand. Remove Ir and coordination edges to identify the two covalent ligand components. Among eligible naphthyl cycles choose the nearest centroid, without fitting a target distance or selecting by energy; publish all eligible ring IDs and distances, then freeze the chosen atom IDs for contact-separated and released comparisons. Exclude directly connected rings within one ligand. Publish centroid and plane-normal definitions; retain distortion and all other geometry changes.
scope: Fix mis-selection of covalently connected NHC rings; same original isomer/stacking question and matrix.
